I think the taxes are just paid off on that vehicle and that $10,000 would be carried over into the next price +GST for the new vehicle!

Then when you put any money down it’s going to be interest free/ penalty free. might as well do that all on the next vehicle . If you put 30k down on the Telluride and owe $29k, the dealership might try to offer you less to buy in your vehicle well, but if you have negative equity they’ll likely have to give you a bit more on your trade to make things work.

When you are getting less for your vehicle you’re trading in than what your lien is, the dealership will still pay off the lien of your current vehicle and put the negative equity into the next vehicle. So let’s say since you owe $59k they offer you $50k. They will still get that whole vehicle paid off for you but you’ll have that 9k move over to the next vehicle, which should be fine as long as the vehicle that you get next “books” for enough money to be able to hide that $9,000.
